name: diagram-design
description: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
one_liner: A tool that turns a plain description into a good-looking diagram (flowchart, org chart, timeline, etc.) that actually matches your brand, instead of the generic boxes AI usually draws.
buyer: A content marketer, technical writer, or indie SaaS founder who currently avoids adding diagrams to blog posts and decks because Figma takes too long and AI-generated ones look ugly.
business_use_cases: A B2B SaaS content team ships on-brand architecture and workflow diagrams for every blog post and case study without hiring a designer.
A consultant builds polished process diagrams for client proposals and slide decks in minutes instead of hours in Figma.
An agency offers a 'diagram refresh' service that redraws clients' messy Mermaid or draw.io diagrams into on-brand editorial visuals.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid library of extra brand-matched diagram themes/templates beyond the free 39 types.
Run a done-for-you diagram service for content agencies: they send content, you deliver branded diagrams, billed per diagram.

steal_this: Offer a $29 'brand diagram pack' service this weekend: customer sends their website URL and rough diagram idea, you deliver 3 on-brand SVG diagrams using this skill.
